objective: Prepare a future audit that compares pre-game predictions against actual results after games complete.
required_inputs: production predictions saved before game start
completed game results after Final status
model metadata and confidence bucket at prediction time
starter, lineup, streak, volatility, venue, close-game, and blowout context available at prediction time
leakage_policy: Audit rows must be written only after game completion and must not be fed back as pre-game features without date-based shift and separate validation.
dashboard_policy: Do not wire the audit log into production dashboard decisions until explicitly requested and validated.
